ns2:course.label: Genetic Algorithm Methods
ns2:course.description: Genetic algorithms search--procedures based on the mechanics of natural genetics and natural selection--are finding increased application to the difficult problems of engineering, science, and commerce. This course surveys what genetic algorithms are, where they come from, how they work, and how and where they have been applied. Prerequisite: CS 101; MATH 241 (formerly MATH 243) or MATH 242.
